ruleDefinitions.name: Execute From Alternate Data Streams
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution from an Alternate Data Stream (ADS). Adversaries may use NTFS file attributes to hide their malicious data in order to evade detection

sequences.query: process_command_line = RGX(".*txt\\:.*") AND (((process_command_line = RGX(".*type\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\>\\ .*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*makecab\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.cab.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*reg\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ export\\ .*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*regedit\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/E\\ .*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*esentutl\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/y\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/d\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/o\\ .*"))))
